_comment: WP7 E4-3D wiring pilot (EXPLORATORY, prereg_guard false). First execution of the multires-pairs machinery on 3D: gmsh3d pairs at coarsen 2.0 from the G1 pilot family, val pairs labelled in-ledger, run_e4 end to end (AR pretrain, inv arms on/off). The 2D K6 verdict (regulariser retired) is frozen and untouched; this run proves the E4-3D wiring and produces the first 3D resolution-transfer gap numbers for Phase-2 design.
